inputs.text: The T-shirt design for DreamShaperXL Turbo features a minimalist tech aesthetic with clean typography inspired by Einstein's famous equation, E=mc2. The design focuses on geometric shapes and sleek lines, representing the modern technology landscape. The monochromatic color palette complements the minimalistic approach, while an accent color adds a touch of visual interest.

Avoid overly complex designs that may not translate well to a T-shirt, as well as low-quality indicators such as pixelation or lack of detail. Poor typography choices and cluttered layouts should also be avoided.
